title: relationship_shift_v1: how a relationship changed over the log window
description: One item per unordered pair whose relationship changed (unchanged pairs may be listed with direction unchanged). The grader treats a and b as unordered. direction compares the start of the log window with its end: warmer or colder; reversed means the relationship crossed from friendly to hostile or the other way. Identity fields for the shuffle comparison: {a, b}, direction, turning_point.

turning_point.description: The single event that changed the relationship most; null when unchanged.

reason.description: Free text for presentation only. Not scored.
